lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is the Ecology Commission taking up a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered leaf blowers in Telluride by 2028 and all other combustion lawn and garden equipment by 2030 — a real code change worth watching if you work in landscaping or just own a leaf blower. The TMVOA also kicks off its three-meeting 2027 budget cycle on Thursday, and the Arts and Special Events Commission works through a stack of event calendar requests including a proposed date shift for the Telluride Jazz Festival.
